prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Next: Pet Controls", "Mastering Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Use hotkeys or tray icon options to interact with, hide, or call your desktop pet anytime.", "Right-click system tray icon to hide or unhide pet", "Press Ctrl+Shift+P to summon pet to cursor"]
1: ["Creating Your Desktop Companion", "Our engine is synthesizing your pet's 3D desktop model and animations."]
2: ["Preparing Desktop Pet Assets", "Your pet is getting ready to land on your desktop screen."]
3: ["Choose Your Pet Creation Path", "Pick Quick Adoption to start instantly, or Custom Studio to craft a unique companion."]
4: ["Signing in ensures your adoptable pets and custom settings remain safely saved to your cloud account across devices."]
5: ["Generation continues seamlessly in the background if you minimize this window."]
6: ["Existing account holder? Sign in now to automatically restore your previously saved desktop pets."]
7: ["Continue to Quick Mastery", "Desktop Pet Quick Controls", "Here is how to interact with your pet once onboarding finishes.", "Click and drag pet anywhere on screen", "Double-click pet to open interaction menu"]
